source.read: 2026-11-04, Blender 5.1.2 background, read only, on a byte-identical copy of the FBX imported to a scratch .blend (feet converted to metres); booklet rendered with PyMuPDF from a copy
source.method: per family instance: mesh islands in the local frame (u along the facade, z up, from the bottom left of the frame extent seen from outside); glass = the inner rectangle of a sash / leaf ring, opaque = a leaf or panel island without an inner hole; curtain walls from the bboxes of their 'Системная панель С остеклением' (glass) and 'Системная панель Стемалит' (opaque) panels; the revolving door from booklet sheet 25 (plan, scale from axes Г-Д = 8400 mm = 475.5 px) and sheet 18 (facade И-А, scale from the entrance curtain wall 7150 mm = 675 px). Rounded to 1 mm.
source.finishes: frames RAL 7021 unless stated (booklet sheet 18 legend: ALT W72 / ALT F50, окраска RAL 7021); stemalit RAL 5024 (opaque); glass clear tempered triplex (D11); gates RAL 7040 (D10); TP annex RAL 7021 (D16)
